script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

Title: "REBOOT"

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

JAMES (30s, tech-savvy but disillusioned) sits on a couch, staring at a blank computer screen. He's lost his latest freelance gig and his bank account is dwindling. He's surrounded by discarded pizza boxes and empty soda cans.

JAMES
(whispering to himself)
I've got to do something. I can't keep living like this.

Suddenly, his old college friend, MARK (30s, successful entrepreneur), walks in, looking concerned.

MARK
(sitting down next to James)
Hey, old friend. I heard about the latest setback. I know it's tough, but don't lose hope.

JAMES
(scoffs)
What can I do? My skills are outdated. I've been applying for jobs, but no one wants me.

Mark pulls out a USB drive.

MARK
I have an idea that might change your life. It's a new technology called "Virtual Mentoring." You'll be able to learn new skills and gain real-world experience from professionals in your field, all from the comfort of your own home.

INT. APARTMENT KITCHEN - DAY

James and Mark are sitting at the kitchen table, going over the details of the Virtual Mentoring program.

JAMES
(excited)
So, I'll be able to interact with these mentors in real-time, and they'll guide me through the learning process?

MARK
Exactly. And the best part is, it's completely virtual. No commute, no dress code, and you can learn at your own pace.

JAMES
(grinning)
This could be a game changer.

INT. MENTORING PLATFORM - DAY

James is sitting at his computer, logged into the Virtual Mentoring platform. He's connected with his first mentor, SARAH (40s, experienced marketing executive).

SARAH
(on screen)
Hello James, I'm Sarah. I'll be your mentor for the next 12 weeks. Our first session will be focused on identifying your strengths and weaknesses in marketing.

JAMES
(nervous)
Hi Sarah. I'm looking forward to learning from you.

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

James is working on a marketing project for one of Sarah's clients. He's making progress, and the apartment is no longer a mess.

Suddenly, his computer screen flickers and goes dark.

JAMES
(frustrated)
What the...?

INT. APARTMENT BEDROOM - NIGHT

James is lying in bed, staring at the ceiling. He's been rejected from several mentoring opportunities and his bank account is almost empty. He feels defeated.

MARK
(entering the room)
You know, sometimes things don't work out the way we plan. But that doesn't mean we give up. You've got this, James. Keep pushing forward.

INT. MENTORING PLATFORM - DAY

James is back on the Virtual Mentoring platform, this time connected with a new mentor, TOM (50s, successful business owner).

TOM
(on screen)
James, I understand you've had some setbacks recently. But don't let that discourage you. Remember, every failure is an opportunity to learn and grow.

JAMES
(determined)
You're right, Tom. I'm ready to give it my all this time.

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - DAY

James is now thriving in his new career, working from home and making progress in his virtual mentoring program. He's no longer surrounded by discarded pizza boxes and empty soda cans. Instead, the apartment is filled with the sound of a humming computer and the occasional clack of a keyboard.

Mark walks in, smiling.

MARK
I'm proud of you, James. You've come a long way.

JAMES
(smiling back)
I couldn't have done it without you, Mark. And the Virtual Mentoring program. It really changed my life.

MARK
(grinning)
That's the power of technology, my friend. Now go out there and show the world what you're capable of.

FADE OUT.

End screenplay.

In this modern sci-fi screenplay, the theme of career transition is explored through the use of a new technology called "Virtual Mentoring." The protagonist, James, faces adversity as he struggles to adapt to the changing job market, but with the help of his friend Mark and the Virtual Mentoring program, he is able to learn new skills and ultimately find success in his career. There is no gun violence, no graphic violence, and no copyrighted characters. Instead, the focus is on the power of technology and the importance of perseverance.
